purpose: Read-only, descriptive plan that prepares the design context for the future 6★ Balance Pass Foundation (RM1.32-B). This document does NOT patch the 6★ catalog and does NOT activate Borea. It records the structural shape, slot counts, expected invariants, risk areas, and recommended numeric range principles that the future 6★ foundation_draft must respect.

borea_handling.notes: greek_borea should receive foundation_draft final_numbers as catalog-only design data in RM1.32-B, but MUST remain hidden in /api/heroes, gacha, and roster. The Marchio Boreale stack mechanic remains Borea-exclusive and must not leak into other 6★ entries. Legacy hero_id 'borea' MUST stay hidden under all circumstances.

current_state_assertions: 78 expected slots total (13 entries × 6 slots each)
13/13 6★ entries carry divine_weapon_id and cross-link 1:1 with Divine Weapon catalog
Marchio Boreale appears only on greek_borea (verified by baseline invariants)
All 6★ entries have ultimate slot present
core_effect_tags are taxonomy-only descriptors (no runtime hookup)
Borea remains catalog-only; runtime not attached

forbidden_changes_in_future_pass: Borea activation / making greek_borea visible in /api/heroes
Marchio Boreale leak to non-Borea entries
allowed_changes_in_future_pass: per-slot final_numbers payload with status='foundation_draft' and runtime_ready=false

recommended_numeric_range_principles.warning: Indicative, descriptive guidance only. No numbers are applied to the catalog by this plan. Final numbers will be drafted in RM1.32-B by the authoring CLI under the safe-write pipeline.

basic.power_envelope: slightly above 5★ basic anchor, no scaling crit, no resource generation beyond ultimate gauge
basic.status_application: none or minor light status (e.g., minor mark)

passive_base.role: identity passive — always-on baseline buff or trigger
passive_base.power_envelope: meaningful but bounded; e.g. +5–10% stat or conditional trigger

skill_1.power_envelope: ~1.3–1.6× basic damage equivalent or strong utility

passive_advanced.power_envelope: stronger than passive_base; gated by trigger condition (HP threshold, status, stack count)
passive_advanced.interaction_focus: divine weapon synergy and faction/element resonance, descriptive only

skill_2.role: second active — typically AoE or strong utility
skill_2.power_envelope: comparable to skill_1 with different shape (AoE, debuff, sustained DoT, etc.)

ultimate.role: 6★ exclusive finisher with strong narrative VFX hook
ultimate.power_envelope: single highest-impact action; long cooldown / gauge-gated
ultimate.divine_weapon_synergy: placeholder — descriptive cross-link only, no runtime effect
ultimate.note: ultimate values are highest-risk slot; must be reviewed manually before any runtime hookup

global_principles: No multiplicative stacking with 5★ foundation values (independent design space)
All numbers reviewable and reversible via authoring CLI + baseline diff
Marchio Boreale stack values stay confined to greek_borea entry
Divine Weapon synergy fields remain descriptive placeholders — no live damage modifiers

risk_areas.risk: highest narrative + numeric impact; easy to over/under-tune
risk_areas.mitigation: draft conservatively; document rationale per entry in authoring_notes

risk_areas.risk: accidental runtime hookup or implicit damage modifier
risk_areas.mitigation: keep as taxonomy / descriptive string only; no numeric modifier in 6★ slot final_numbers

risk_areas.risk: leak into non-Borea entries; over-tuned stack cap
risk_areas.mitigation: baseline diff validator already enforces no leak; future draft must confirm stack cap range

risk_areas.risk: taxonomy drift if new tags introduced silently
risk_areas.mitigation: reuse existing taxonomy from RM1.30-B; any new tag must go through audit_6star_effect_tags_taxonomy

risk_areas.risk: future task accidentally flips runtime_attached / battle_runtime_attached to true
risk_areas.mitigation: baseline diff + invariant checks fail on flip; runtime hookup gated by SKILL_KIT_RUNTIME_ENABLED feature flag (RM1.33-A)

risk_areas.risk: future task could unhide greek_borea in /api/heroes or gacha
risk_areas.mitigation: API smoke + roster invariants enforce hidden status; baseline invariants record expected hidden state

acceptance_invariants_for_rm132b: 5★ catalog must remain unchanged (foundation_draft already in place)
6★ catalog gets foundation_draft final_numbers on 78/78 slots
All runtime flags remain false (entry-level and slot-level)
After RM1.32-B is approved, a new baseline v4 must be created to absorb the legitimate 6★ SHA change
out_of_scope: final balance values finalization (a later separate task)
